_status_doc: USGS CA_SanDiegoCo_D24 (2024) source lidar, class-2 ground returns, read at every station; nothing filled, nothing smoothed (an empty cell is null and flagged)

crs.pyproj_description: Inverse of UTM zone 11N + NAD83(2011) to WGS 84 (1) (with axis order normalized for visualization)
crs.pyproj_definition: proj=pipeline step inv proj=utm zone=11 ellps=GRS80 step proj=unitconvert xy_in=rad xy_out=deg

frame.what: Lake Murray engine frame = data/centerline.local.json: x east, z north (metres), y = NAVD88 height - origin.elev_m; finished_centerline.json carries z negated (AC axis)
frame.projection: lon/lat -> x = (lon - lon0) * m_lon, z = (lat - lat0) * m_lat, WGS84 series at lat0 (scripts/geometry/projection.py)

line.station_doc: s_m = metres along the line's own xz polyline from v0
line.offset_doc: offset + = LEFT of the line's travel (v increasing); on College northbound (v1100-1500) + is west. Cell centre = (x, z) + offset * (nx, nz)

params._doc: every UPPER CASE number is [invented]. A cell = |offset - o| <= BIN_HALF across and |along| <= ALONG_M; its height = an along-line linear fit h = h0 + g * along evaluated at the station (removes the grade's bias), refit after trimming residuals over max(TRIM_K * 1.4826 MAD, TRIM_FLOOR_M); the median when fewer than FIT_MIN returns

cells_doc: row per station (stations.v order), column per offsets_m

flag_bits.1: EMPTY: no class-2 return in the cell (h null)
flag_bits.8: TRIMMED: more than 25 % of the cell's returns rejected as outliers
flag_bits.16: SPIKE: more than 0.3 m from the median of its 3 x 3 (station x offset) neighbourhood
